issues.problem: Wrong sign. The workbook line is 'Other operating (income) expense, net', so its negative monthly values are net income. FY2026 should print as +18,129 (net income), not (18,129). The prior year's 17,644 was converted correctly, so the error affects the current year only.
The sign error flows into the computed totals. Operating profit is understated by 36,258, and so are Profit before tax (12,690,640 vs 12,726,898) and Profit for the year (9,263,509 vs 9,299,767).
issues.evidence: Sum of P&L R13 B:M (Operating income) = 12,645,199. Sum of R16 B:M (Income before income taxes) = 12,726,898. Sum of R18 B:M (Net income) = 9,299,767. 'Cash Flow'!B16 Net income = 9,299,767.

issues.problem: The retained earnings movement shows a profit of 9,263,509, which does not match the workbook's 9,299,767. As a result, the movement does not add up: 8,014,489 + 9,263,509 - 124,484 = 17,153,514, but the closing figure printed (and on the balance sheet) is 17,189,772. Correcting the other operating income sign resolves this.
